name: query_openfda
description: Query FDA drug database for drug information including brand names, indications, and adverse events
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_openfda; result = query_openfda('ibuprofen')

parameters.drug_name: str — drug name (generic or brand, e.g. 'ibuprofen', 'aspirin')

returns: dict with keys: drug_name, brand_names, indications, contraindications, adverse_events (top), source
